expanded: (Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / EBITDA (TTM). Computed in expanded_metrics.py -- EBITDA lives in metric_value, not canonical_fact, so calculate.py's generic engine can't reach it.
(Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / EBITDA (TTM)
(Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / Revenue (TTM)
Trailing P/E / EPS Growth Rate (YoY, as a percentage number, e.g. 15 not 0.15)
Dividend Yield + Buyback Yield - Dilution (share-count growth, TTM)

Sum of Form 13F-reported institutional holdings (deduped per filer, amendment preferred over original -- same dedup as apps/site's getTopInstitutionalHolders) / Shares Outstanding. Does NOT require price -- computed in expanded_metrics.py.

(Shares Outstanding now - Shares Outstanding ~1yr ago) / Shares Outstanding ~1yr ago. Same dilution figure already folded into total_shareholder_yield, exposed here as its own visible data point -- e.g. a buyback-yield-positive company can still be net-diluting via SBC issuance, which total_shareholder_yield alone hides. Does NOT require price -- computed in expanded_metrics.py.
(Inventory / Cost of Revenue) x 365, FY only
(Accounts Payable / Cost of Revenue) x 365, FY only
Debtor Days + Inventory Days - Payables Days, most recent FY each. Computed in expanded_metrics.py -- combines three METRIC outputs, not raw concepts, same pattern as net_debt_ebitda.

Standard 9-test Piotroski F-Score (0-9), FY vs prior FY. Computed in mapper/quality_score.py -- a composite requiring 9 raw concepts across 2 fiscal years each, doesn't fit this engine's single-period per-role model. Null for financial institutions by design (Piotroski's own methodology needs a classified current/non-current balance sheet + gross margin, which banks don't report).
1 if (CFO - CapEx) > Net Income for the fiscal year, else 0. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, per FY year.

1 if total_debt == 0 for the fiscal year, else 0; null (not 0) if total_debt wasn't reported at all that year -- absence is not evidence of debt-free status. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, per FY year.

Consecutive most-recent FY years with positive net income, counted backward from the latest year until a non-positive or missing year breaks the streak. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, one value as of the latest FY only (not a per-year series).

1 if gross margin strictly increased across the 3 most recent CONSECUTIVE FY years, else 0; null if fewer than 3 consecutive years of data exist. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, one value as of the latest FY only.
(Revenue[t] / Revenue[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py -- a purely additive GROWTH_METRICS entry, same mechanism as the locked 3Y CAGR.
(Revenue[t] / Revenue[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Diluted EPS[t] / Diluted EPS[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Diluted EPS[t] / Diluted EPS[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Basic EPS - Diluted EPS) / Basic EPS -- a dilution-quality signal distinct from share_dilution_trend (which tracks share-COUNT change, not the basic-vs-diluted EPS gap itself)

(Accounts Receivable[FY] - Accounts Receivable[FY-1]) - the company's own reported cash-flow-statement IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable[FY]. A quality-of-earnings cross-check, not a locked ratio -- a large gap flags AR movement the cash-flow statement's own adjustment doesn't explain (e.g. an acquisition/divestiture, reclassification), not necessarily an error. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py -- needs a prior-FY balance-sheet lookup this engine's single-period model can't express.
Same cross-check as ar_change_reconciliation_gap, for Inventory. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py.
Same cross-check as ar_change_reconciliation_gap, for Accounts Payable. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py.

Reported Effective Tax Rate - (Income Tax Expense / Income Before Tax). A cross-validation signal for ROIC's own internally-derived tax rate -- a large gap flags a company with material discrete tax items (one-time credits/charges) that year, not necessarily an error in either figure. Computed in mapper/tax_reconciliation.py.
(FCF[t] / FCF[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, FY only. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py -- FCF is a computed metric_value, not a raw canonical_fact, so ttm.py's generic growth engine can't reach it directly.
Same as fcf_growth_3y_cagr, 5-year lag. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py.

Consecutive most-recent FY years with dividends_per_share strictly increasing, counted backward from the latest year until a flat/decreasing year breaks the streak. Null (not 0) for a company with no dividend history at all. Computed in mapper/dividend_streak.py, one value as of the latest FY only.

(Dividends per Share[t] - Dividends per Share[t-1]) / Dividends per Share[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year. Computed in mapper/ttm.py -- a purely additive GROWTH_METRICS entry, same mechanism as the locked revenue/EPS growth metrics.
(Dividends per Share[t] / Dividends per Share[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, FY periods. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
Cash from Operations + Cash from Investing + Cash from Financing -- the period's own bottom-line cash movement, distinct from net_cash (a balance-sheet POSITION: Cash - Total Debt).
Cash from Operations / Net Income -- an earnings-quality signal (a real, cash-backed profit should track CFO closely; a large or growing gap flags aggressive accrual accounting).

Dividends Paid + Share Buybacks -- the total cash actually distributed to shareholders in the period, before relating it to Market Cap (that ratio is total_shareholder_yield's job) or to Free Cash Flow (see share_repurchases_pct_fcf/dividends_pct_fcf, computed in expanded_metrics.py).
Total Debt / EBITDA (TTM) -- gross leverage, distinct from net_debt_ebitda (which nets out Cash & Equivalents first). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.
Free Cash Flow (TTM) / Shares Outstanding. Computed in expanded_metrics.py.

Share Buybacks (TTM) / Free Cash Flow (TTM) -- what fraction of real cash generation went to buybacks, distinct from buyback_yield (which relates buybacks to Market Cap, not FCF). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.

Dividends Paid (TTM) / Free Cash Flow (TTM) -- a cash-based payout coverage check, distinct from payout_ratio (Dividends per Share / Diluted EPS, an earnings-based payout ratio -- the two can diverge meaningfully whenever CFO and Net Income diverge). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.
(Net Income[t] - Net Income[t-1]) / Net Income[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

(Shares Outstanding[t] - Shares Outstanding[t-1]) / Shares Outstanding[t-1]. Uses the same shares_outstanding concept as share_dilution_trend (this project has no separate diluted-weighted-average-shares concept yet -- see doc/learnings/2026-09-05-financials-spec-gap-plan.md); unlike share_dilution_trend (a rolling ~1yr comparison anchored on 'today'), this is a real FY-vs-prior-FY series. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Shares Outstanding[t] / Shares Outstanding[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(Shares Outstanding[t] / Shares Outstanding[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
(FCF[t] - FCF[t-1]) / FCF[t-1], FY only. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py -- same reasoning as fcf_growth_3y_cagr/5y_cagr (FCF is a computed metric_value, not a raw canonical_fact).

ap_change_reconciliation_gap: Difference between the balance-sheet payables movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
ar_change_reconciliation_gap: Difference between the balance-sheet receivables movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
book_value_per_share: Stockholders' equity divided by shares outstanding.
buyback_yield: Trailing twelve-month share buybacks relative to market cap.
cash_conversion_cycle: Debtor days plus inventory days less payables days.
cash_returned_to_shareholders: Dividends paid plus share buybacks for the period.
current_ratio: Current assets relative to current liabilities.
debt_to_ebitda: Total debt relative to trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
debt_to_equity: Total debt relative to stockholders' equity.
debtor_days: Accounts receivable relative to annual revenue, expressed in days.
diluted_shares_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual growth in diluted shares outstanding over three fiscal years.
diluted_shares_growth_5y_cagr: Compound annual growth in diluted shares outstanding over five fiscal years.
diluted_shares_growth_yoy: Change in diluted shares outstanding versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
dividend_growth_streak_years: Consecutive latest fiscal years with increasing dividends per share.
dividend_yield: Trailing twelve-month dividends per share divided by price.
dividends_pct_fcf: Dividends paid relative to trailing twelve-month free cash flow.
dps_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual growth in dividends per share over three fiscal years.
dps_growth_yoy: Change in dividends per share versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
ebitda: Operating income plus depreciation and amortization.
ebitda_margin: Trailing twelve-month EBITDA as a share of revenue.
effective_tax_rate_gap: Difference between the reported effective tax rate and the rate derived from tax expense.
eps_dilution_spread: Difference between basic and diluted EPS relative to basic EPS.
eps_growth_10y_cagr: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over ten fiscal years.
eps_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over three fiscal years.
eps_growth_5y_cagr: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over five fiscal years.
eps_growth_yoy: Diluted EPS growth versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
ev_ebitda: Enterprise value relative to trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
ev_sales: Enterprise value relative to trailing twelve-month revenue.
fcf: Cash from operations less capital expenditure.
fcf_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual free-cash-flow growth over three fiscal years.
fcf_growth_5y_cagr: Compound annual free-cash-flow growth over five fiscal years.
fcf_growth_yoy: Change in free cash flow versus the same fiscal year one year earlier.
fcf_gt_net_income: Binary flag: 1 when free cash flow exceeds net income; otherwise 0.
fcf_margin: Free cash flow as a share of revenue.
fcf_per_share: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow divided by shares outstanding.
fcf_yield: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow relative to market cap.
gross_margin: Gross profit as a share of revenue.
institutional_ownership_pct: Recent Form 13F-reported holdings relative to shares outstanding.
interest_coverage_ratio: Operating income relative to interest expense.
inventory_change_reconciliation_gap: Difference between the balance-sheet inventory movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
inventory_days: Inventory relative to annual cost of revenue, expressed in days.
margin_expanding_3yr: Binary flag: 1 when gross margin increased across three consecutive fiscal years.
net_cash: Cash and equivalents less total debt.
net_cash_per_share: Net cash divided by shares outstanding.
net_change_in_cash: The period's total cash movement across operating, investing, and financing activities.
net_debt_ebitda: Debt less cash relative to trailing EBITDA.
net_income_growth_10y_cagr: Compound annual net income growth over ten fiscal years.
net_income_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual net income growth over three fiscal years.
net_income_growth_5y_cagr: Compound annual net income growth over five fiscal years.
net_income_growth_yoy: Change in net income versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
net_margin: Net income as a share of revenue.
ocf_to_net_income: Cash from operations relative to net income -- an earnings-quality signal.
operating_margin: Operating income as a share of revenue.
payables_days: Accounts payable relative to annual cost of revenue, expressed in days.
payout_ratio: Dividends per share relative to diluted EPS.
peg_ratio: Trailing P/E divided by year-over-year EPS growth.
piotroski_f_score: Nine-test financial-strength and operating-quality score from 0 to 9.
pretax_margin: Income before tax as a share of revenue.
price_to_book: Market cap relative to stockholders' equity.
price_to_sales: Market cap relative to trailing twelve-month revenue.
profitable_streak_years: Consecutive latest fiscal years with positive net income.
quick_ratio: Current assets excluding inventory relative to current liabilities.
revenue_growth_10y_cagr: Compound annual revenue growth over ten fiscal years.
revenue_growth_3y_cagr: Compound annual revenue growth over three fiscal years.
revenue_growth_5y_cagr: Compound annual revenue growth over five fiscal years.
revenue_growth_yoy: Revenue growth versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
rnd_intensity: Research and development expense relative to revenue.
roa: Net income relative to total assets.
roe: Net income relative to stockholders' equity.
roic: After-tax operating return on invested capital.
sbc_pct_revenue: Stock-based compensation as a share of revenue.
sga_pct_revenue: Selling, general and administrative expense relative to revenue.
share_dilution_trend: Change in shares outstanding over approximately one year.
share_repurchases_pct_fcf: Share buybacks relative to trailing twelve-month free cash flow.
total_shareholder_yield: Dividend yield plus buyback yield, less share-count dilution.
trailing_pe: Price divided by trailing twelve-month diluted EPS.
zero_debt: Binary flag: 1 when reported total debt is zero; otherwise 0.

v1: NOPAT / Invested Capital, where NOPAT = Operating Income x (1 - Income Tax Expense / Income Before Tax) and Invested Capital = Total Debt + Stockholders' Equity - Cash & Equivalents. v1 formula, pinned 2026-08-16 with real evidence -- see module docstring.
(Revenue[t] - Revenue[t-1]) / Revenue[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year
(Diluted EPS[t] - Diluted EPS[t-1]) / Diluted EPS[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year
